instruction: I need to adjust VLC's volume settings. Please change the maximum volume limit to 150% in VLC Media Player so I have a bit more headroom without going too high.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC's maximum volume to 150%. The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_max_volume metric to verify that qt-max-volume is set to 150. Another variation of the max volume setting task with a different target value.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to set VLC max volume to 150%
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC config file from OS-specific location
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses the config file and checks qt-max-volume setting
Expected value (150) matches the instruction's requirement exactly
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Logic handles edge cases: missing config file, missing config key (uses default '125'), type conversion
Complete coverage: single requirement (max volume = 150%) is fully verified
